[RLOW.3.4.1] The lifecycle does not change the schema's slot layout. It is
recorded in the lifecycle atom (`SchemaLogical` or `SchemaTtl`) and consumed by
the engine's fact-assert path. Each slot keeps its position and type whichever
lifecycle the schema has; a `logical` schema's `Slot` atoms additionally carry
each slot's identity role and tolerance ([RLOW.3.6.1], [RLOW.3.7.1]).
